body:
JobsyDiscord is a lightweight Paper 1.21.11 plugin that promotes your Discord server by sending automatic clickable chat broadcasts every 30 minutes. Players can click the message to instantly join your Discord, while Bedrock players (via Geyser/Floodgate) also see a clear fallback link.

It also includes a simple /discord command with permission support, allowing players to view and access the server invite anytime. Fully configurable through config.yml, server owners can easily change the Discord link and broadcast interval without recompiling.
